2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.529 of 2022 under sections 323, 506, 376D IPC and 67 IT Act, P.S. Vibhuti Khand, District Lucknow.

3. The FIR in question was lodged alleging that the victim was aged about 32 years and on 07.08.2022 at about 12:45 am, the applicant came to the home of the victim and started misbehaving with her and forcibly undress her and committed the offence under section 376 IPC.

1 and a notary of affidavit of marriage was prepared.
Subsequently, the allegations were made against two other persons who had come at the instance of the applicant and committed the same offence.

4. The counsel for the applicant argues that the said two other persons are the real brothers of the applicant and the victim is the tenant in the house of the applicant and when she was asked to vacate the premises, she has resorted to make false allegations.

He further argues that Ranjeet Yadav and Ajeet Yadav who are the brothers of the applicant have been granted anticipatory bail by this court vide order dated 03.04.2023 till the submission of the charge-sheet.

The statements made in the first information report are so improbable i.e. difficult to believe as the applicant herself stated that they had married and a notary certificate was prepared, thus, even otherwise the allegations may not be established.

The applicant is in custody since 18.08.2022 and in another case shown against him,
he is on bail.

5. Considering the fact that the co-accused who are the brothers of the applicant were granted anticipatory bail and the allegations are highly improbable, as such, the applicant is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Ajay Yadav be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 21.7.2023 VNP/-
